summary: REQ-46 is largely implemented. The diff adds a second hardcoded admin seed (username: admin, password: Admin@1234, role: admin) to both the upsertSeedUsers() helper (called in postupgrade) and the migration.mo file. The existing genmitra seeds are preserved. However, there is no explicit system func init() call to upsertSeedUsers(), which is one of the acceptance criteria. The frontend login flow is unchanged (non-goal), so that AC is implicitly satisfied by the backend change.

missing_requirements.requirement: The system func init() in backend/main.mo must upsert the admin / Admin@1234 / role admin record into stable storage.
missing_requirements.reason: The diff shows a upsertSeedUsers() helper called in postupgrade(), but there is no system func init() defined or shown calling upsertSeedUsers(). The diff only shows system func preupgrade() {} and system func postupgrade() { upsertSeedUsers() }. The init() function is absent from the diff, so this acceptance criterion is not confirmed as implemented.

hallucinated_features.description: A 'user' seed account (username: user, password: 1234, role: user) is upserted in both migration.mo and upsertSeedUsers(), but only the genmitra user seed (username: genmitra, password: 1234) was part of the original requirements. Adding a separate 'user' username seed was not requested.
hallucinated_features.reason: The build request constraints specify the existing genmitra user seed (username: genmitra, password: 1234, role: user) should be preserved, but the diff adds a new 'user' / '1234' seed that was never mentioned in the requirements.
